Create: steam 'n rails tutorial / guide 1.18.2 - 1.19.2 (minecraft java edition)

order.note: Guides always open on tracks. Steam n Rails' first-contact feature is simply that every wood type gets its own track, so the mod is visible from the very first rail you place, long before any machinery.

Gauges come after plain tracks and are crafted FROM a finished standard track via a Create sequenced assembly - cut, deploy, press. You cannot make a wide or narrow track directly, so standard track is a hard prerequisite.

The handcar is presented as the thing you build BEFORE committing to a real train - it replaces the throwaway station-plus-casing-plus-seat contraption players used to assemble just to travel their own line.
Couplers are the mid-tier goal: splitting and joining trains automatically is what turns a decorative railway into logistics.

gates.note: HARD GATE, stated in two separate videos: the remote lens only binds to a conductor that is WEARING GOGGLES. Without the goggles the item does nothing, and nothing in the item's own recipe hints at this.
Remote control of a train goes through a redstone link placed on the conductor, not on the train.

IMPORTANT NON-GATE - do not build progression on this. The liquid fuel system exists but trains do NOT require fuel unless a config flag is switched on. With it off, a fuelled and an unfuelled train race at identical speed. Treat fuel tanks as optional flavour, not a power requirement.
Track buffers placed directly against a station will trap a train - it cannot be driven off. Leave a gap. Observed live as a bug in the update video.

traps.note: TRAP: bogies can be placed on the top and the bottom of a monorail track, but bogies that touch each other's sticky faces merge into a single carriage and the train refuses to assemble. Monorail builds need deliberate spacing between bogies.

Minor trap/annoyance flagged by the guide: there is no quick way to switch a placed track between standard, wide and narrow. Each gauge is a separate crafted item, so committing a long line to the wrong gauge is expensive to undo.

signature.note: THE headline feature and the one thing guides call a must-have. A deployer holding a wrench can assemble and disassemble a train automatically, which base Create cannot do at all - in base Create you must walk to a station and do it by hand, and nothing on an assembled train can be interacted with.
Track switches are the feature the audience explicitly asked base Create for and did not get. The andesite and brass switches are treated as the mod justifying itself.

The phantom track is called the most beautiful addition in the mod - a fully functional track that turns invisible unless you are holding track, enabling floating trains and boats on invisible rails. Pure spectacle, very high desirability.

Smokestacks plus the locometal palette are what make a Steam n Rails train look like a real locomotive; they are dyeable and cycle through variants, and the guide dwells on them at length. Cosmetic, but it is a large share of why people install the mod.
Signalling and conductor kit round out the mod's identity as 'real railway operations' rather than Create's minimal train system.
